newsitem.title: USA: Florida Public Utilities names chairman.
newsitem.headline: Florida Public Utilities names chairman.

text.p: Florida Public Utilities Co said Wednesday it has named Franklin Cressman chairman and John English president and chief operating officer.
The company said Cressman will continue as chief executive officer, while relinquishing the duties of president and chief operating officer to English.
Cressman fills a board chairmanship that has been vacant since 1991, the company said. Cressman had been president, chief executive and chief operating officer since 1991.
English had served as senior vice president since 1993, the company said.
